question.text: Which of the following treatment will convert starch directly into glucose?

solution.text:
Fermentation by diastase will convert starch into maltose but not into glucose.

Zymase does not effect starch.

Further, dilute NaOH will not hydrolyse starch because the various glucose units in it are linked to each other by glycosidic (ether) linkage which are resistant to hydrolysis by NaOH. Thus only dilute H2SO4 will hydrolyse starch into glucose.

The two stands of DNA are complementary to each other and the bases of one stand are paired with the bases of other strand by means of hydrogen bonding, i.e., A = T and G≡C . But uracil (U) instead of thymine (T) is present in case of RNA. Thus, the sequence of base on m-RNA molecule is

DNA strand 5'-AGCTACACT-3'

m-RNA 5'-UCGAUGUCA-3'
